origin_definitions.origin: End of current hourly row at integer ICULOS t; label exactly at ICULOS t+h in the same sequence.
origin_definitions.future_labels: Nonmissing finite published target cells at exact horizon, without requiring any input history.
origin_definitions.partial_context: Between one and24 existing hourly slots in [t-23,t], with at least one finite observed value across the34 dynamic variables in that window.
origin_definitions.full24_context: All24 integer hourly slots [t-23,t] exist and at least one dynamic measurement exists anywhere in that window; individual cells may be missing.
origin_definitions.sequence_counts: ICU records/files, not asserted unique people across admissions.
origin_definitions.label_independence: A nonmissing published hourly value is not proof of a new independently drawn sample at that hour.
origin_definitions.uncertainty: q10/q50/q90 requested; sample counts do not establish predictive calibration.
origin_definitions.aggregation: 15minute observations or within15minute mean/min/max cannot be recovered from hourly rows.

evidence.counts_pre_quality_note: Finite published cells are not independent sampling events; quality/unit audit may reduce usable counts. Counts are not training or calibration metrics.

eligibility_policy: Retain every dynamic variable and every physically/analytically valid observed value as candidate; missing values are not zeros.
For each variable,horizon and split report actual label pairs and independent sequence counts.
No arbitrary easy-variable selection; unsupported test/calibration cells report NA/insufficient evidence, not zeroerror.
Zero training labels for one head means untrained output; do not present as calibrated prediction.
Rare variables remain in planned heads; absence of usable labels blocks claims, not archival retention.
context_sensitivity: Compare shortversus24h contexts at identical origins and separately evaluate warmstarts; report sample losses from fullcontext requirement.
no_claim: These hourly terrestrial data do not establish24h astronaut performance or clinical decision thresholds.

target_semantics.definition: Value associated with terminal interval ending at t+h; not cumulative mean over(t,t+h].
target_semantics.published_value_policy: Use source published cell without asserting it is a true hourly mean/min/max; preserve documented source aggregation.
target_semantics.laboratory_policy: Only actual observed laboratory results assigned to the terminal interval; no interpolated or forward-filled labels.
